金，一名私人防身術教練，她甚至在市中心有自己的練習空間。

前特殊部隊退役的金，外型亮眼，只收女學員，打造女學員放心練習的空間。

上一輪的預約課程已經結束，讓她這段時間能空出時間，補強自身的訓練。

就在她揮汗如雨的進行拳擊訓練時，門被推開，一名女性走了進來。

/
「歡迎..」她回頭，愣了下。
很漂亮，纖細的女性，黑中帶紅的長髮。

/
「金教練是嗎？」

「是我，請問是要預約私人課程嗎？」她拿起一旁的毛巾擦去身上的汗水。

ChatGPT
D.Golden was a private self-defense instructor who ran her own training studio right in the middle of the city.

A former special forces operative, she had the looks to draw attention almost anywhere she went. Yet her studio had one particular rule: she only accepted female clients, creating a space where her students could train without feeling intimidated or uncomfortable.

Her last scheduled session had just ended, leaving her with some rare free time to work on her own training.

The rhythmic thud of her fists against the punching bag echoed through the otherwise quiet studio.

D.Golden wiped sweat from her brow before throwing another sharp combination.

Jab.

Cross.

Hook.

She was completely absorbed in her workout when the front door opened.

D.Golden glanced over.

"Welcome..."

The word died halfway through.

A woman had just walked inside.

She was beautiful—slender, poised, with long hair that was dark at first glance but carried a subtle red tint beneath the light.

D.Golden stared for half a second longer than she intended.

The woman noticed.

D.Golden immediately looked away and reached for the towel beside her.

'Get a grip.'

The woman walked toward her, her expression calm and composed.

"You're D.Golden, right?"

"That's me."

D.Golden wiped the sweat from her face and nodded toward the reception area.

"Are you here for a private lesson?"

/
女子從上衣的口袋掏出一張名片，遞給金。

/
深紅商業集團，紅...
沒有職銜？
但是直覺讓金認為對方不是簡單人物。

/
「我來學防身術，受夠了那些隨扈了。」

/
金露出專業笑容。
「如果女士妳是需要配備隨扈的身份，通常防身術是不能取代的。」

「我知道。」紅突然靠上去。
摟住金的脖子，環抱著她。

「！..紅小姐...？？」她錯愕了一下，但沒有推開紅。

『怎麼回事？..』

ChatGPT
The woman slipped a business card from the pocket of her top and held it out to D.Golden.

D.Golden accepted it.

Deep Red Business Group.

E.Red.

There was no position listed beneath the name.

That was strange.

Someone important enough to have an escort detail usually had a title printed on their card. Yet somehow, the lack of one made D.Golden even more suspicious.

Her instincts told her this woman was not ordinary.

'I should probably be careful.'

E.Red spoke as though the matter were perfectly straightforward.

"I'm here to learn self-defense. I'm tired of having bodyguards following me around."

D.Golden gave her a professional smile.

"If you're someone who normally requires personal security, ma'am, self-defense usually isn't a substitute for an escort team."

"I know."

E.Red stepped closer.

Before D.Golden could react, the woman slipped an arm around her neck and pulled her into an easy embrace.

D.Golden froze.

"Wh—... Miss E.Red...?"

She stared down at the woman beside her, completely caught off guard.

Yet she didn't push her away.

'What is going on...?'

E.Red simply remained there, looking entirely unbothered by the sudden closeness.

D.Golden's ears slowly turned red.

She cleared her throat.

"Um..."

For someone who had spent years training to remain calm under pressure, she suddenly found herself having absolutely no idea what to do with her hands.

而城市的另一邊。

「大小姐又跑出去了？找私人防身術教練？好好調查她！」集團總裁，也就是紅的父親放不下嚴肅。

「..是。」紫回應。
她是總裁的人，不是紅的人。
即使和紅年齡相仿，甚至戀慕著紅。

紫內心知道自己更多時候是父親的眼線跟報馬仔這種討厭的傢伙。

紅對她並沒有好臉色。

/
「又要抓我回去交差？」

「大小姐，總裁先生很擔心妳。...」

「我才不在乎。他也只是怕我被綁架，給他帶來麻煩吧。」

「大小姐，請不要怪我。」

「紫，妳！放我下來！」

被扛回車上的千金，和無奈的集團的爪牙。

這樣的事情發生太多次了。

ChatGPT
Meanwhile, on the other side of the city...

"Miss E.Red ran off again? And now she's looking for a private self-defense instructor? Investigate her thoroughly!"

The president of the Deep Red Business Group spoke with a stern expression, clearly unable to let the matter go.

"...Yes."

L.Night answered quietly.

She worked for the president.

Not for E.Red.

Even though she was around E.Red's age, and even though she had long harbored feelings for her, L.Night knew exactly what her role was.

More often than not, she was her father's informant.

His eyes.

His messenger.

The annoying person who always had to report everything back.

And E.Red had never exactly treated her kindly for it.

---

"You're here to drag me back again?"

"Miss E.Red, the president is very worried about you..."

"I don't care."

E.Red crossed her arms, clearly irritated.

"He's only worried that I'll get kidnapped and cause trouble for him."

"Miss E.Red, please don't blame me."

"That doesn't mean—L.Night! Put me down!"

L.Night had already hoisted E.Red over her shoulder and was carrying her toward the waiting car.

"Sorry, Miss E.Red."

The young heiress kicked indignantly in protest.

"Put me down!"

"I'm afraid I can't."

A furious heiress being carried back to the car.

And the helpless corporate operative assigned to retrieve her.

It was hardly an unusual scene anymore.

In fact, this had happened far too many times.

ChatGPT
It didn't take long for L.Night to find her.

And, naturally, E.Red was right there.

D.Golden was standing beside her, one hand gently supporting E.Red's arm as she guided her through the proper way to transfer her weight into a punch.

"Keep your shoulder relaxed. Don't put all the force into your arm."

"Like this?"

"Exactly."

"Excuse me..."

L.Night's voice drifted across the room, slightly weary.

She had already predicted the storm that was about to hit.

E.Red and D.Golden turned around at the same time.

"Idiot..." E.Red muttered under her breath.

"You two know each other?" D.Golden asked.

"Throw her out, D.Golden. Please."

E.Red immediately grabbed the pocket of D.Golden's boxing shorts, clinging to it as though it were a lifeline.

D.Golden froze for a moment.

She really wasn't sure what she was supposed to do with that.

"Um... my lady's curfew has passed."

"Curfew my ass!"

E.Red pulled a face at L.Night.

"I'm twenty-five! I know perfectly well what I'm doing!"

She promptly ducked behind D.Golden.

That was when D.Golden finally understood.

The purple-haired young woman in light tactical gear must be the so-called bodyguard E.Red had been complaining about.

"E.Red doesn't want to go with you."

"She doesn't have a choice."

L.Night sighed again.

"Neither do I."

D.Golden stepped between the two women.

"You can't take her away without her consent."

Her expression turned serious as she looked directly at L.Night.

"And you can't do it without my permission, either."

ChatGPT
"Oh? Want to test that?"

L.Night rolled up her sleeves.

"Gladly."

D.Golden lowered her stance, settling into a fighting position.

"Good stance. But..."

L.Night suddenly swept her leg forward with blinding speed.

E.Red let out a startled gasp and hurriedly stepped back.

D.Golden didn't dodge.

Instead, she stepped forward, caught L.Night's incoming leg, and immediately countered.

"!"

L.Night twisted free and retreated several steps.

'She actually caught my attack head-on?!'

D.Golden narrowed her eyes.

'This purple-haired one is fast...'

She watched L.Night's movements carefully.

'But...'

There.

A weakness.

D.Golden moved.

L.Night barely had time to react before D.Golden's fist struck her lower abdomen.

"Kh..."

L.Night staggered back.

D.Golden had maintained her training consistently for years. L.Night certainly had an excellent foundation, but in recent years, her primary duty had been 'managing' E.Red.

Their difference in current conditioning was beginning to show.

'Don't mess around...'

L.Night swallowed the pain and straightened herself, pretending nothing had happened.

"L.Night?!"

The change in E.Red's expression caught D.Golden's attention.

Concern.

Genuine concern.

D.Golden paused.

Her eyes shifted briefly between the two women.

'Ah.'

The corner of her mouth lifted slightly.

'So that's how it is.'

She lowered her fists.

'Looks like I don't need to teach her too harshly after all.'

『....輸得一塌糊塗啊，紫。』

ChatGPT
After a few more exchanges, L.Night remained firmly on the losing side.

She could even tell that D.Golden's attacks had become less aggressive than they had been at the beginning.

It was almost as though she were deliberately adjusting her pace to match L.Night's current level.

'...You're getting completely beaten here, L.Night.'

L.Night took a step back.

There was no point dragging this out.

"All right... I'll tell the president that Miss E.Red is still 'taking lessons.'"

She glanced toward D.Golden.

"And the instructor..."

L.Night gave a small, resigned smile.

"She's actually quite good."

She rubbed her nose, then pressed a hand against the spot on her lower abdomen where she'd been hit earlier.

D.Golden had controlled the force perfectly.

If she'd genuinely wanted to knock L.Night down, that punch would have been much worse.

'She was holding back that much...?'

L.Night sighed.

Her eyes drifted toward E.Red, who was peeking out from behind D.Golden.

Then she turned and walked out through the training studio's doors.

---

"Now then, Miss E.Red."

D.Golden folded her arms.

"Would you mind telling me what's really going on?"

E.Red finally explained.

The strict restrictions placed on her.

The constant monitoring.

Back when she was still studying, she'd been able to tolerate it.

But even after entering the workforce, she still wasn't given the slightest bit of freedom.

D.Golden listened quietly.

"And that woman named L.Night...?"

"She's an orphan the president took in."

E.Red's expression became slightly complicated.

"She grew up training with the group's security team. She was basically raised to become my personal shadow."

"And to drag me home."

E.Red gave a quiet huff.

D.Golden watched her carefully.

She was good at reading people.

Her former special forces training had even included emotional-recognition exercises.

And right now, E.Red's expression was telling her something very clearly.

Whatever E.Red might say out loud...

Her feelings toward L.Night were definitely not as simple as the annoyance she claimed.

ChatGPT
Over the next few days, the president's arranged blind dates with men became so relentless that E.Red was nearly driven insane.

L.Night could only stand by helplessly most of the time.

Whenever E.Red gave her a subtle signal, L.Night would step in—either giving the unfortunate suitor a polite but unmistakably firm warning, or playing the villain and dragging E.Red away herself.

It had become a routine.

Until one day, back at the training studio, E.Red wrapped her arms around D.Golden again.

"D.Golden..."

"Uh? Miss E.Red, are you all right?"

E.Red looked up at her.

Then, with a stubborn and determined expression, she asked,

"Could you be my girlfriend?"

D.Golden froze.

"You've got to be joking, right? Don't tease me, Miss E.Red."

"I'm not joking."

E.Red's arms tightened slightly around her.

"If I had a girlfriend as amazing as you, surely the president would finally stop arranging all those ridiculous dates."

She tilted her head, then added with a mischievous smile,

"Or maybe they'd have to fight you before they could take me out to dinner?"

D.Golden couldn't help but laugh awkwardly.

"Miss E.Red, I really don't think relationships work like that..."

She still tried to turn her down as gently as possible.

"Then what am I supposed to do?"

E.Red lowered her gaze.

"The president would never let me be with that idiot L.Night, anyway."

D.Golden's expression softened.

She sighed.

"I still don't think using a fake relationship to get around all this is a good idea..."

"Hmph."

E.Red looked up again.

"Or do you think I'm not cute?"

"What?"

D.Golden blinked.

"Do you think I don't look like a proper little girlfriend?"

"That's not what I meant, Miss E.Red..."

"Or are you married?"

"I'm not married~ Miss E.Red."

D.Golden could only laugh helplessly.

ChatGPT
That evening, as usual, L.Night arrived to 'remind' E.Red that her lesson was over.

"L.Night, I have something to tell you."

L.Night already looked exhausted.

"Hm?"

"And you need to tell the president, too."

E.Red deliberately wrapped her arms around D.Golden.

"I'm together with D.Golden now."

She looked up at D.Golden with an unmistakably sweet expression.

"Right, D.Golden~?"

"Uh...?"

D.Golden's smile froze.

L.Night stared blankly at the two of them.

"Okay, okay. I understand. Congratulations."

She casually turned toward the door.

"Now hurry home, Miss E.Red."

E.Red blinked.

"You're not surprised at all?"

She puffed out her cheeks slightly.

D.Golden, meanwhile, looked increasingly awkward.

"Miss E.Red has pulled this trick before."

L.Night slipped both hands into her pockets.

"But I'll admit, this fake girlfriend is pretty impressive."

She glanced at D.Golden.

"I'll give you that."

'So this is a regular thing...'

D.Golden couldn't help but laugh quietly to herself.

In a strange way, she felt relieved.

After all, she really wasn't prepared to have one of her female students actually fall for her.

Apparently, E.Red had found a fake girlfriend before.

That made things much simpler.

And yet...

For some reason, there was a tiny, inexplicable sense of disappointment in her chest.

D.Golden quickly pushed the feeling aside.

'Probably nothing.'

她將頭探往後座，紅上前吻住她的唇。

ChatGPT
On the drive back, L.Night was the first to break the silence.

"About you and D.Golden..."

"What about it? None of your business~"

E.Red was sitting in the back seat, looking out the window.

"...You two haven't gone too far yet, have you?"

L.Night glanced at her through the rearview mirror.

"We're talking about D.Golden, not you, silly L.Night..."

E.Red lowered her head slightly.

"......"

"......"

L.Night tightened her grip on the steering wheel.

"E.Red... I still hope that between us..."

"What?"

E.Red continued staring out the window.

"You've seen how the president reacts. He'll object to practically anyone."

"Unless it's some wealthy man he's personally approved of."

"...That's true."

There was a brief silence.

"L.Night."

"Hm?"

"Do you really think that's what's best for me?"

L.Night answered without hesitation.

"Of course not."

She sighed.

"Wouldn't that just be another prison? If it were me, I wouldn't want it either."

"Right..."

E.Red's expression softened.

---

Just before getting out of the car, E.Red spoke quietly.

"L.Night. Come closer."

L.Night knew what this meant.

It had become almost a habit between them.

She leaned toward the back seat.

E.Red moved closer and pressed a brief kiss to her lips.

She only pulled away when she was satisfied.

"Remember, okay?"
